task: Common online coverage feasibility before another semantic experiment

mode_scope.N: Pure coverage selection throughout the shared runtime
mode_scope.G: Geometry and reconstruction quality with shared coverage budget protection

eligibility: coverage >= 0.8, returned_to_anchor, zero collisions, termination.failed == false
reference_mode: Read only existing frozen V19 caches; never copy, regenerate or modify
world_scope: Existing V19 generic stereo surrogate, perfect pose and artificial RGB markers; not ZED calibration
truth_boundary: Evaluator truth and true coverage never enter runtime arguments or feedback
